observe.title: {1} Observation Request
observe.text.0:
Hello, I represent {0}. We are very interested in observing the behaviour of {1} in captivity.

If you were able to construct an enclosure with the following parameters and allow us to observe it for a period of time, we could compensate you for your efforts.
observe_complete.title: Observation Complete!
observe_complete.text.0: We were able to watch the {1} in captivity and learned a lot about their behaviour.
observe_2.title: Observation Request
observe_2.text.0:
Hello, I'm contacting you on behalf of {0}. We have funding for one of two potential observation studies. The first study looks at the behaviour of {1} while the second looks at {2}.

Would you be willing to work with us on one of these studies? And if so which one?
observe_3.title: {1} Group Observation
observe_3.text.0:
Hello from {0}. Field research has indicated peculiar tendencies among {1} when in large aggregations. We want to carry out a study of {1} in captivity.

If you are able to construct a tank with the following parameters and allow us to set up observation cameras for a period of time, we could compensate you for your efforts.
observe_3.reply.0: I'd be glad to help with your study.
observe_3_complete.title: Observation Concluded!
observe_3_complete.text.0: The results of the {1} study are in and are truly fascinating. Thank you so much for your cooperation.
